messages.body:
On Wed, Oct 14, 2020, Pandey Anwesh wrote:
>Hello amber team..I am getting following error and therefore not able to
>fully complie. Pls help!!
...one long single line omitted here...
It would help to know what commands you gave to try to build. But it
looks like you don't have some or all of the bzip2 (and maybe zlib)
libraries installed. Be sure to check out the Centos 7 requirements
here:
https://ambermd.org/InstCentOS.php
...hope this helps...dac
